reserveReview.rationale: 2026-07-30 re-review. Current PicWe docs and gitbook still assert Phase 1 100% USDC backing with 1:1 mint/redeem and 'on-chain reserves' / 'real-time auditability', but publish no itemized reserve inventory, attestation, or PoR report (docs.picwe.org transparency/reserves/proof-of-reserves paths 404). On-chain pins contradict a simple full USDC float: BSC block 113074656 (2026-07-30T20:34:28Z) WEUSD totalSupply 32433.922065 with mint/redeem contract 0x5D54…F22C holding only ~0.624899 USDC (BSC USDC 0x8AC7…580d balanceOf); Movement legacy package 0xed80…f83d (DefiLlama Movement supply source) reports weusd::total_supply 465086.702603 while weusd_operations::MintState holds stablecoin_reserves 58.232342 (6-dec) and move_reserves 1343.060443 with move_ratio 1000 — dual-asset mint state, not pure USDC, and far below circulating supply; current PicWe package 0xf39c…1ff6 MintState holds stablecoin_reserves 841.166803 + cross_chain_reserves 16637.901559 against weusd::total_supply 841.166803. CoinGecko WEUSD ~$0.64. No public ratio table reconciles docs, legacy dual-reserve mint-state, EVM mint underfill, and market price. Composition therefore remains a single unresolved 100% residual (not a forced USDC link).
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Issuer Phase-1 USDC documentation re-checked against multi-chain mint/reserve contract reads and market price; unresolved dual-disclosure conflict retained
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: Actual reserve mix, weights, and locations are undisclosed: current docs claim 100% USDC while the dominant Movement supply package stores dual MOVE+stablecoin mint-state fields, EVM mint contracts do not hold matching USDC, and no attestation reconciles liabilities to assets.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: 2026-07-30: PicWe still names no bank, trust, or qualified custodian for WEUSD reserves. Documented custody is issuer-operated smart-contract mint/redeem infrastructure (EVM CREATE2 mint 0x5D54…F22C; Movement current package 0xf39c…1ff6 and legacy package 0xed80…f83d holding MintState reserve counters). Legal segregation, bankruptcy remoteness, rehypothecation/anti-rehypothecation terms, successor-custody mechanics, and failure-domain isolation from PicWe admin EOAs / package upgrade keys are unpublished. Security docs mention multi-sig and timelocks generically without identifying reserve custody controllers.
